"""Camera-based controller for the single MealPrepStaging episode."""
import json, pathlib, numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot
ROOT=pathlib.Path('/app/runs')
r=Robot()
spec=r.spec()
(ROOT/'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec,indent=2))
obs=r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none')
obs.save(ROOT/'initial')
print(json.dumps(spec,indent=2))
print(json.dumps(obs.meta,indent=2))
PY
